name: Public landing page and contact information render
description: Checks the public information and direct contact routes are visible without an administrator area.
steps: Review the mission, vision, how it works and five welfare pathways
expected: The public landing page shows BOW information, the phone number 08086001110 and the contact QR image, with no admin or management tools.

name: Applicant form prepares a WhatsApp support request
description: Verifies a visitor can complete an application and continue with the prepared details in WhatsApp.
steps: Submit the form empty and confirm required fields are enforced
Complete name, phone, Help Desk, address and support reason
expected: The browser opens WhatsApp with the applicant details prepared and explains that the applicant must send the message to deliver it.

name: Partner form prepares a WhatsApp partnership enquiry on mobile
description: Verifies a partner can prepare an enquiry without a backend or account.
expected: WhatsApp opens with the partner enquiry details and the public page remains usable on mobile.
